subject: ARLO SEO — Monthly — September 2026
html:
ARLO SEO — Month 3 Review (September 2026)

Covering 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30, reported 2026-10-01. This also closes the original 12-week-strategy.md window (kickoff 2026-07-04 + 12 weeks ≈ 2026-09-26) — this report folds in the W12 review the 2026-09-01 report flagged: score months 1–3 together, refresh the keyword map, and decide whether the goal metric flips toward leads or the ramp needs more runway.

Honest frame, stated up front: askarlo.app is a 3-month-old domain (SE Ranking Domain Trust 6, up from 5) on a 6–12 month organic ramp. Per 12-week-strategy.md's own KPI ladder, Months 1–3 were leading-indicator months — indexation, first tracked rankings, off-page trust signals, human blockers cleared — not leads. Measured against that bar, this is the third straight month the metrics outside this routine's control (rankings, backlinks, human-gated decisions) came up empty, while content execution inside its control stayed on pace with zero regressions. Zero rankings after 3 months on KD 9–31 terms is not yet alarming for a brand-new domain — but a completely flat referring-domain count and an unsubmitted GSC sitemap, both for 3 full months on self-serve tasks, are the pattern most worth a human's attention now.

Leads / CPL (GA4 conversions, proxy metric)

Pending — unchanged for a 3rd straight month. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) has been firing since 2026-07-04, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 Reporting API access, so conversion counts can't be pulled from here. By design this stays a non-goal until pages actually rank — and with 0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked anywhere after 3 months, that condition still hasn't been met. A human checking the GA4 console directly would finally close a 3-month-old "pending," independent of the ranking question.

What's working

  • Content execution held pace and quality for a 3rd straight month. 12 build-gated sessions in September: 2 net-new/expanded content pieces (a "Tableau alternative" comparison section on /destinations/tableau, a "Google Sheets alternative" comparison section on /destinations/google_sheets built off a freshly-confirmed 590/mo keyword signal rather than a guess), 5 correctness/technical-SEO fixes (dangling publisher @id in connector-matrix JSON-LD, site-wide security headers, two rounds of sitemap.ts lastModified staleness fixes, /privacy+/terms added to the sitemap), and 5 weekly-pulse sessions — zero shipped regressions, every session build-gated (npm run build clean). GitHub Actions: 43/43 "SEO Report Email" runs green all-time, including every run this month.
  • Two sessions caught real, previously-unflagged bugs instead of just adding volume — the schema fix and both sitemap fixes corrected inaccurate signals Google was already receiving, the same "verify against current source, not stale audit prose" discipline that also caught and discarded a near-duplicate blog draft and two false-alarm audit findings (a phantom missing schema, a vanished page hub) this month.
  • The FOCUS keyword cluster keeps validating the thesis even with zero rank movement: live re-pull today shows claude mcp server 880→910/mo, mcp connector 810→880/mo, meta ads mcp 590/mo (flat, still gated), google analytics mcp 590/mo (flat), google search console mcp 390/mo (flat) — every tracked term either holding or climbing, none softening, across 9+ consecutive re-pulls since kickoff.
  • Domain Trust ticked up again (5→6) and index_google: 1 holds — Google continues crawling and trusting the domain more each month even without a human ever completing GSC sitemap submission.
  • The connector matrix and comparison hub stayed fully caught up against every live-pulled signal this routine could find without guessing — not idle, genuinely out of human-independent page-building work in those two engines for most of the month.

What's not working

  • Zero rank movement for a third consecutive month. Live pull today (PROJECT_getPositionHistory, 2026-09-01→10-01, daily): average position sat at exactly 100 (SE Ranking's not-ranked floor) on every single day — 0 of 22 tracked keywords have registered a measurable position at any point since tracking began on 2026-08-01, two full months running. Month 3's own goal (de-escalated to just one keyword showing any position) was not met.
  • Off-page link acquisition has now been completely flat for 3 straight months. Live pull today: still 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 (3+ weeks) and structurally unchanged since kickoff — both referring domains are still the same futurlabs.dev sister-site cross-link, not earned links. Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub — all ~15–30-minute self-serve web forms) remains 0 of 6, now 2 months past its Week-4 target with no sandbox path to self-serve any of them (no outbound HTTP).
  • Every human-decision blocker set as a Month 3 goal is still open, and getting worse, not better. catalog.ts re-checked byte-for-byte: all 9 gated connectors (meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages — May 2026 ETA, now 5 months overdue; shopify — April 2026 ETA, 6 months overdue; tiktok_ads/stripe — June 2026, 4 months overdue; hubspot/mailerlite — July 2026, 3 months overdue; mailchimp — August 2026, 2 months overdue) remain coming_soon — every single gated connector in the catalog is now simultaneously overdue, several by half a year. The dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and GSC sitemap submission (open since kickoff, 2026-07-04, now a full 3 months) are both still unresolved.
  • AI-engine visibility has no baseline after 3 full months. PROJECT_listLlmEngines still returns an empty list — the AI Result Tracker has never been configured with a single LLM engine on this project, so the GEO/AEO investment (FAQPage schema across 6+ pages, structured connector/comparison pages, llms.txt) still has nothing measurable to show. This needs a one-time human setup step in the SE Ranking console, not another session re-flagging it.
  • The two specific Week 9 content items named in the Month 3 goal didn't ship. Neither a dedicated claude mcp server pillar page (a blog post covering the term exists from August, but no standalone top-of-funnel pillar page) nor the ChatGPT-assistant-column connector variant (still blocked on the same open human check flagged since 2026-08-06) shipped this month — September's content sessions went instead to the Google Sheets/Tableau comparison sections and technical-correctness fixes, which were real, justified choices in the moment, but the two named Week 9 items are still outstanding.

Numbers vs. Month-3 targets (set 2026-09-01)

KPIMonth-3 targetActualStatus
First measured SERP position≥1 of 22 tracked keywords (de-escalated from Month 2's ≥15)0 of 22 — avg position flat at 100 every day, 2026-09-01–10-01❌ Not met
Off-page Phase 12–3 of 6 directory/registry listings shipped0 of 6 — still 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 09-10❌ Not met
Human decisions closedcatalog.ts pass, persona-route scaffold, GSC submission completed0 of 3 — all still open; catalog.ts now 9 of 9 gated connectors overdue (was 5 of 5)❌ Not met
W9–11 content itemsclaude mcp server pillar page + ChatGPT-assistant columnNeither shipped; 2 other justified pieces shipped instead (Tableau, Google Sheets comparison sections)❌ Not met as specified
Leads/CPL proxyStays "pending" unless rankings appearPending — no rankings appeared, GA4 still unqueryable from this sandbox✅ As designed
Pages/fixes shipped (quality bar ~2/wk)~8–9 over the month2 net-new content pieces + 5 correctness/technical fixes + 5 pulses = 12 build-gated sessions✅ On pace
Domain Trustn/a (directional signal)5 → 6🟢 Small positive movement
CI healthn/a (directional signal)43/43 "SEO Report Email" runs green, all-time✅ Green

Score — Month 3 goal: Missed (1 of 6 measurable KPIs met: Leads/CPL staying "pending" as designed; content pace was on pace but the two specifically-named W9 items were not the ones shipped)

Content execution has now stayed on pace for 3 straight months with zero shipped regressions and two real bugs caught and fixed from live evidence this month alone — the routine itself is working as designed. But every metric it doesn't fully control came up empty for the third month running: 0 of 22 keywords have ever registered a position, the referring-domain count hasn't moved since before Month 1, and all 3 human-decision blockers from the Month 3 goal are not just still open but measurably worse (catalog.ts overdue count nearly doubled, from 5 to 9, as more ETAs lapsed). Unlike Month 1's partial credit (wiring up rank tracking turned out to be self-serve) there has been no equivalent discovery in Months 2 or 3 — off-page listings and GSC submission both need a human with a browser, which this sandbox does not have and cannot route around.

12-week window review (W12, per 12-week-strategy.md's own instruction)

Scoring Months 1–3 together: Month 1 earned partial credit (rank tracking itself turned out to be self-serve, closing a 4-week-old blocker); Months 2 and 3 were both scored Missed on their measurable KPIs, with the underlying numbers essentially unchanged between them — 0 ranked keywords both months, referring domains flat at the same 2 sister-site links since before the plan started, and the same 3 human-decision blockers open at the end of all 3 months. Against that record, the call is: do not flip the goal metric to leads yet — there is no ranking signal of any kind to build a leads correlation against, and doing so now would substitute a fabricated number for an honest "pending." Zero rankings after 3 months on KD 9–31 terms for a brand-new domain is still inside the normal (if slow) range for the stated 6–12 month ramp, not a sign the plan has failed — but a 3-month flat-zero on the two cheapest, fastest, most human-dependent items on the entire plan (GSC submission, 6 directory listings) is the one place this review recommends a human spend 30 minutes of actual browser time before Month 4, independent of whatever this routine does next. Month 4 extends the ramp rather than closing out the original 12-week window on schedule; the plan's own Week 9–12 items (long-tail connector variants, a claude mcp server pillar page, digital PR, SXO fixes on the weakest pages) become the content backlog going forward.

Adjustments for next month

  • Stop re-logging the off-page and GSC blockers as routine NEXT items and keep escalating them at report-level, as this and the prior report have done — both are 100% blocked on human browser access this sandbox does not have, and re-checking them every session without a human update is pure overhead. This report makes it explicit a 3rd time: 30 minutes of a human's time on 6 self-serve forms plus one GSC sitemap submission is the single highest-leverage open item on the entire 3-month-old plan.
  • catalog.ts needs one human pass across all 9 now-overdue entries to mark each either genuinely shipping soon (a real new ETA) or live/soft-launched (unblocks new connector-matrix pages) — re-verifying "still coming_soon" every session with no human update attached is no longer informative on its own.
  • Actually ship the two named-but-undelivered W9 items next month: a dedicated claude mcp server pillar page (910/mo and climbing, the single highest-volume term in the whole thesis, still only covered by an August blog post rather than its own page) and, if the 2026-08-06 human check ever resolves, the ChatGPT-assistant-column connector variant.
  • sxo.md (audited 2026-07-04) has not been re-verified against current code the way technical.md/onpage-schema.md were on 2026-09-28 — its priority list (e.g., naming a "Supermetrics alternative" page as not existing, when /compare/supermetrics-vs-arlo has shipped since July) is now stale in at least that respect. A future session should re-read it end-to-end against current source before treating any of its remaining findings as actionable, the same discipline that caught two stale findings in technical.md/onpage-schema.md on 09-28.

Goal — Month 4 (October 2026)

1) First measured SERP position for any of the 22 tracked keywords — carried over unmet for a 2nd time; the bar stays at ≥1 rather than escalating, since forcing a higher target wouldn't change Google's own crawl/index timeline. 2) Off-page Phase 1: ≥2 of the 6 directory/registry listings actually shipped by a human, and GSC sitemap submission actually completed — both flagged for the 3rd consecutive month as the highest-leverage, lowest-effort open items on the plan. 3) Human decisions closed on catalog.ts (9 of 9 gated connectors now overdue, several by 5–6 months) and the persona-route scaffold. 4) Ship the claude mcp server pillar page and, if unblocked, the ChatGPT-assistant connector column — the two Month-3 content items that didn't land. 5) Re-verify sxo.md against current source (same discipline applied to technical.md/onpage-schema.md on 2026-09-28) before treating any of its remaining findings as new work. 6) Leads/CPL proxy stays "pending" through Month 4 unless rankings actually appear; if they do, this is the trigger to start pulling GA4 conversions as the real goal metric.
